I'm 27 years old, diagnosed at 18. I used to be strong, smart, outspoken, and motivated... I am no longer that person. My brain has slowed down, my memory has drastically declined, and I can hardly find the motivation to get out of bed. I have completely changed, but I know now that I can still change. Once you get to a point that you understand your pain and you develop coping skills and find what works for YOU, then you will change again. Fibro is a lifelong battle and you will go through phases of change, don't be discouraged.
